item.title: Opposing Patterns of the Histone Variant MacroH2A1.1 in Fmr1 Knockout and BTBR T+ Itpr3tf/J Mouse Models of Autism Spectrum Disorder.
item.description:
Must read · Molecular neurobiology · section: Neurodevelopmental Disorders & Rare Diseases · topic is in the title · model: knockout / conditional mouse · source: Primary / trusted · fits the Neurodevelopmental Disorders & Rare Diseases definition: strong · published this week

item.title: O-linked β-N-acetylglucosamine homeostasis in brain health and disease: From physiology to neurodevelopmental and neurodegenerative disorders.
item.description:
Worth reading · Neural regeneration research · section: Neurodevelopmental Disorders & Rare Diseases · topic is in the title · source: Uncurated · fits the Neurodevelopmental Disorders & Rare Diseases definition: moderate · published this week
Controlled by the opposing activities of O-linked β-N-acetylglucosamine transferase and O-GlcNAcase, O-GlcNAcylation regulates thousands of nuclear, cytoplasmic, synaptic, and mitochondrial proteins involved in gene expression, neuronal differentiation, synaptic plasticity, proteostasis, mitochondrial homeostasis, and neuroimmune signaling.
